en: Vintage sepia postcard showing a large U‑shaped barracks courtyard. A long two‑story building with a tiled roof, dormer windows, and an arched entrance gate dominates the background. In the foreground, several children play with hoops while a man leads a horse; carts and a lamp post are also visible. Printed caption text at the top identifies the place as the barracks in Pontarlier and credits a local publisher.
